representations.activation_semantics: Application supplies instructions and user input to Responses API. Output is a request fragment, not an API call.
representations.authority_semantics: Stable instructions are separate from user input. A request fragment does not grant platform or filesystem privileges.
migration_notes: No endpoint call or default model is embedded. Output-schema prose is not an enforced API schema; strict structured-output configuration is outside this minimal emitter.
representations.scope_semantics: Per request. Application owns session state, retries, tool execution, approvals, secrets and model choice.
validation_rules: No toolkit metadata in the native artifact.
No executable interpolation of untrusted source text.

support_scope: Responses instructions/input request fragments; no SDK installation, live calls or strict output-schema wiring.
